CustomField.formula: CASE(TEXT(PeriodType__c), "Month", DATE(ReferenceYear__c, PeriodNumber__c, 1), "Semester", IF(PeriodNumber__c = 1, DATE(ReferenceYear__c, 1, 1), DATE(ReferenceYear__c, 7, 1)), "Trimester", IF(PeriodNumber__c = 1, DATE(ReferenceYear__c, 1, 1), IF(PeriodNumber__c = 2, DATE(ReferenceYear__c, 4, 1), IF(PeriodNumber__c = 3, DATE(ReferenceYear__c, 7, 1), DATE(ReferenceYear__c, 10, 1)))), "Annual", DATE(ReferenceYear__c, 1, 1), null)
CustomField.label: Period Begin Date
